total.rationale: G2 adds opt-in source/EmitIR/output tracing in focused modules, including independently verified static calls, ownership and cleanup facts. Review these observational additions and preserve the minimum 1000-line reserve. All central orchestration and per-file ceilings remain unchanged.

fict-compiler.rationale: Attach the optional graph only to successful explanation output; existing bounded-result validation also covers its serialized payload.

fict-compiler-oxc.rationale: G2 owns its trace schema, source-plan collection and post-codegen census in separate modules. Explain-disabled compilation skips collection; exact final call spans and CommonJS import identities are tested independently. No central builder, codegen or individual file ceiling is raised.

fict-emit.rationale: Async helpers and accessor aliases are verified in EmitIR; alias planning is extracted and repeated kind checks are shared without raising file ceilings.

fict-hir.rationale: Explicit async source/accessor distinctions and an iterative immutable-alias query, including conditional and logical selections.

fict-reactivity.rationale: Track async-dependent implicit values separately from explicit manual accessors to preserve JavaScript function-call semantics.

crates/fict-compiler-oxc/src/emit_codege.rationale: Keep the remaining dispatcher bounded while lowering and optimizer logic moves into focused submodules.

crates/fict-compiler-oxc/src/hir_builder.rationale: Temporary ceiling for the central builder while binding, control-flow, JSX, and ownership logic moves into focused modules.
Bound the extracted fixed-point engine while individual transfer functions and state domains are separated.

crates/fict-compiler-oxc/tests/hir_build.rationale: Preserve the frozen semantic corpus while test scenarios are split by independently reviewable language domain.

crates/fict-compiler-preview/src/lib.rs.rationale: Keep preview-only orchestration bounded while shared request and result policy remains in the core compiler.

crates/fict-compiler/src/pipeline.rs.rationale: Reserve is limited to orchestration fixes while stage-specific analysis and validation moves to owned modules.

crates/fict-compiler/src/reactive_write_.rationale: Keep cross-pass validation bounded while provenance, alias, and replay rules are decomposed by invariant.

crates/fict-compiler/tests/reactive_writ.rationale: Retain semantic coverage while large regression groups are split into focused ownership and mutation suites.

crates/fict-compiler/tests/pass_manager..rationale: Keep pass scheduling coverage bounded while stage contracts are moved beside their owning implementations.

crates/fict-emit/src/lower.rs.rationale: Limit the central lowering dispatcher while syntax-family lowering is extracted into focused modules.
